notes.title: Don't worry, we are alive and kicking! Pricing Updates and more
notes.content:
First, the good news: I'm not dead, I'm not retiring, and I'm not going anywhere just yet. I have at least one more Adults Only game coming out, hopefully by the end of the year. After that I would like to make at least one M rated game... but it's too soon to talk about that. That would be next year.

So, I'm not running away, but I did have a bit of a panic that I have now overcome. I appreciate those that reached out after my last announcement.

Recently, I ran into issues discounting products due to policy changes and regional pricing. I was only able to discount about 3 products, and the discounts were very modest. But due to the pricing issues, that was all I could do at the time. I considered never trying to do discounts again.

After some consideration I decided to devote the time to go into my account and manually adjust prices to avoid issues for now. While there is an automated system for this, it is not consistent. 

I based the prices on Valve's suggested minimum pricing per region, and adjusted products accordingly...for about 35 currencies. These changes are under review, and may take some time before they completely process. I did not use Valve's suggestions per price point, because this is where things are not consistent.

About 280 price changes have been submitted. Prices will increase in most areas to comply with current policies. I hope I do not have to do this again. These price increases are vital, without them I can not discount my products. I think we all know how important discounts are!

Now with the boring stuff out of the way, look forward to a new game pretty soon. I hope the store page will be submitted and approved in the next two weeks.

Thanks for the support, 
See ya soon!

notes.title: Ashmedai: Queen of Lust is coming to Steam!
notes.content:
[i]Ashmedai: Queen of Lust [/i]is coming to Steam on June 24th!

Battle your way through Hell with your curvy party members, knocking out all the pretty ladies that get in your way. With over 30 unique enemies there is plenty of eye-candy! Collect the best gear, expand your party and unlock hundreds of CG images.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37971818/712f46d5042a7bac5b07274a930c63f8c9a165f0.jpg[/img]

Ashmedai gets accompanied by some colorful partners, including the lovely Jade, a fallen champion from the Pure Lands. Now that seems like an odd pair! More party members are introduced via the story and there are some optional party members that you might have to get lucky to find.

Don't forget, there is a curvy shop keep too! Be sure to save up your gold.

Be sure to wishlist [i]Ashmedai: Queen of Lust [/i] today!
